_comment: What the code index (scripts/common/lib/datrix_scripts/code_index, wrapped by scripts/dev/code-index.ps1
and served to agents by scripts/dev/lib/code_index_mcp.py) covers. The index indexes every Python file git
sees in each repository at the workspace root (tracked, plus untracked files no .gitignore excludes),
minus 'exclude'. Every pattern is an fnmatch pattern over the workspace-relative path with forward
'exclude': files never indexed -- checked-in generated output is not framework source.
'module_roots': directories a dotted module name is computed from (the nearest matching ancestor
wins; a file under none takes its repository as the root). They are where the code is imported from:
each package's src/, and every scripts lib/ directory (common/lib holds the datrix_scripts package; each
other lib/ is its scripts' own sys.path[0]).
'summarize': files a local model is asked to summarize by code-index.ps1 -Summarize.
